📢 Announcement Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.3) — Local Web, PHP, Mailpit & Database Stack by Darius Cumpio (MIT)

New in Lite Version 0.1.3: Apache Web Server (Drag & Drop www/ Hosting), PHP 8.4 / 8.3 / 8.2, Mailpit Local Email Testing Server (:8025 / SMTP :1025), SQL Server 2025 (17.x) .bak & .sql Restore/Backup, and 1-Click Self-Repair.

🔧 Repair Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.3)

        
      

      

        

          Diagnoses and repairs missing portable folders (www/, bin/, data/,
          etc/, logs/, tmp/), corrupted settings.json or engine
          config files, stale PID locks (e.g. PostgreSQL postmaster.pid), and MS SQL Server LocalDB
          instances — while keeping all your databases in data/ untouched.
